network.name: SeismicRiskBN
network.description: This Bayesian Network represents conceptual relationships among earthquake characteristics, site conditions, structural condition, fragility, vulnerability, and seismic risk.
network.notes: Node descriptions define the semantic meaning of variables and states. No numerical probabilities or ground-truth CPT information are provided.

nodes.name: Distance
nodes.definition: Distance represents the distance from the structure or site to the earthquake source or epicenter.
nodes.entity: Structure or site under seismic assessment.

states.name: Short
states.meaning: The structure or site is close to the earthquake source.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure or site is at an intermediate distance from the earthquake source.

states.name: Long
states.meaning: The structure or site is far from the earthquake source.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition considered for a seismic event or seismic assessment scenario.
nodes.notes: Distance is represented as an ordered categorical variable from closer to farther.

nodes.name: Magnitude
nodes.definition: Magnitude represents the severity or released energy of an earthquake event.
nodes.entity: Earthquake event considered in the seismic assessment.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The earthquake has low magnitude or low released seismic energy.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The earthquake has intermediate magnitude or intermediate released seismic energy.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The earthquake has high magnitude or high released seismic energy.

nodes.temporal_context: Observed or assumed for the earthquake event being assessed.
nodes.notes: Magnitude is represented as an ordered categorical variable from lower to higher severity.

nodes.name: ShakingIntensity
nodes.definition: ShakingIntensity represents the level of ground shaking experienced at the structure or site.
nodes.entity: Structure or site affected by the earthquake event.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The site experiences low ground shaking intensity.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The site experiences intermediate ground shaking intensity.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The site experiences high ground shaking intensity.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition during the earthquake event or seismic scenario.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of ground motion intensity at the site.
nodes.notes: Shaking intensity is an ordered category describing the severity of ground motion.

nodes.name: SeismicHazard
nodes.definition: SeismicHazard represents the level of earthquake hazard affecting the structure or site.
nodes.entity: Structure or site exposed to seismic action.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The structure or site is exposed to a low level of seismic hazard.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure or site is exposed to an intermediate level of seismic hazard.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The structure or site is exposed to a high level of seismic hazard.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition assessed for a seismic event or seismic hazard scenario.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of the hazard level acting on the structure or site.
nodes.notes: Seismic hazard is represented as an ordered category from lower to higher hazard.

nodes.name: ConstructionQuality
nodes.definition: ConstructionQuality represents the quality of design, materials, construction practices, and structural detailing.
nodes.entity: Structure or building under seismic assessment.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The structure has low construction quality, poor materials, inadequate detailing, or deficient construction practices.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure has intermediate construction quality, materials, detailing, or construction practices.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The structure has high construction quality, good materials, adequate detailing, or reliable construction practices.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition associated with the construction and current assessment of the structure.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of structural construction quality.
nodes.notes: Construction quality is represented as an ordered category from poorer to better quality.

nodes.name: StrengthDegradation
nodes.definition: StrengthDegradation represents the reduction of structural strength due to deterioration, aging, damage, or material degradation.
nodes.entity: Structure or building under seismic assessment.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The structure has low degradation of structural strength.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure has intermediate degradation of structural strength.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The structure has high degradation of structural strength.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition at the time of the structural or seismic assessment.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of the current level of structural strength degradation.
nodes.notes: Strength degradation is represented as an ordered category from lower to higher degradation.

nodes.name: LiveLoad
nodes.definition: LiveLoad represents the variable load acting on the structure, such as occupants, furniture, equipment, and temporary loads.
nodes.entity: Structure or building under seismic assessment.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The structure is subject to a low level of live load.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure is subject to an intermediate level of live load.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The structure is subject to a high level of live load.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition considered at the time of seismic assessment or during the seismic scenario.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of variable imposed load level.
nodes.notes: Live load is represented as an ordered category from lower to higher load.

nodes.name: Fragility
nodes.definition: Fragility represents the tendency or likelihood of the structure to suffer damage under seismic loading.
nodes.entity: Structure or building exposed to seismic loading.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The structure has low fragility and is less susceptible to damage under seismic loading.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure has intermediate fragility and moderate susceptibility to damage under seismic loading.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The structure has high fragility and is more susceptible to damage under seismic loading.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition under the seismic loading scenario being assessed.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of structural damage susceptibility.
nodes.notes: Fragility is represented as an ordered category from lower to higher damage susceptibility.

nodes.name: Vulnerability
nodes.definition: Vulnerability represents the susceptibility of the structure to damage or loss when exposed to seismic effects.
nodes.entity: Structure or building under seismic risk assessment.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The structure has low vulnerability to damage or loss.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure has intermediate vulnerability to damage or loss.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The structure has high vulnerability to damage or loss.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition considered during seismic risk assessment.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of structural susceptibility to seismic damage or loss.
nodes.notes: Vulnerability is represented as an ordered category from lower to higher susceptibility.

nodes.name: SeismicRisk
nodes.definition: SeismicRisk represents the overall risk of seismic damage or loss for the structure.
nodes.entity: Structure or building exposed to seismic hazard.

states.name: Low
states.meaning: The structure has low overall seismic risk.

states.name: Medium
states.meaning: The structure has intermediate overall seismic risk.

states.name: High
states.meaning: The structure has high overall seismic risk.

nodes.temporal_context: Condition assessed for the seismic event or scenario.
nodes.measurement_context: Qualitative classification of expected seismic damage or loss risk.
nodes.notes: Seismic risk is represented as an ordered category from lower to higher risk.
